build_differentiable_star_planner: build a DifferentiableStarPlanner module to compute differentiable A-star paths on 2D obstacle maps
run_path_planning_forward: run the DifferentiableStarPlanner forward pass with obstacle maps, start and goal coordinates to find a path
reconstruct_path_from_costmap: reconstruct the optimal path from goal to start using the g_map cost map after planning
create_soft_argmin_layer: create a SoftArgMin layer to compute differentiable weighted argmin coordinates on a 2D cost tensor
create_hard_argmin_layer: create a HardArgMin layer to compute the exact argmin coordinates on a 2D cost tensor
